# sh-profile-card

Purpose: Member card for lists and feeds. Pick a Type, then edit Info, then the photo overlay.

Profile card (migration, not yet core) · 8 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=2579-25592) (node `2579:25592`)

## Anatomy

Layer tree of `Type=Connect`. Nested components are shown by name; their internals live in their own blueprint.

- root — frame
  - Photo — **sh-photo-wrapper**
  - Info — column · fixed × hug
    - Info — **sh-profile-card-info** (Age 26, Badge 3 instance, Badge 2 instance, Details line 1 5' 6" • Kashmiri Pandit, Badge 1 instance, Details line 2 Pimpri-Chinchwad • Software Developer, Name Sneha Kaul)
  - Top row — row · fixed × hug
    - Tags — row · fill × hug
      - sh-tag — **sh-tag** (Leading icon (Small) instance, Trailing icon (Small) instance, Trailing icon (Medium) instance, Leading icon (Medium) instance, Label Top Profile, Mode White, Size Medium, Shape Rounded) · hidden by default
      - sh-tag — **sh-tag** (Trailing icon (Medium) instance, Leading icon (Small) instance, Trailing icon (Small) instance, Leading icon (Medium) instance, Label Promoted, Mode White, Size Medium, Shape Rounded)
    - Actions — row · hug × hug
      - Photo action — **sh-icon-button** (Icon (Medium) instance, Icon (Translucent Large) instance, Icon (Small) instance, Icon (Translucent Medium) instance, Icon (Large) instance, Icon (Translucent Small) instance, Screen reader label View photos, Badge 10, Type Translucent, Size Small, State Default)
      - More action — **sh-icon-button** (Icon (Medium) instance, Icon (Translucent Large) instance, Icon (Small) instance, Icon (Translucent Medium) instance, Icon (Large) instance, Icon (Translucent Small) instance, Screen reader label More options, Badge 2, Type Translucent, Size Small, State Default)
